verdict.rationale: Pricing docs are published per-MTok with no sales contact required (claude-supp-pricing), and the Admin API docs confirm API keys can be created/managed 'by hand in the Claude Console' or programmatically (claude-docs-18/42), implying self-serve key creation exists. But the evidence pack has no explicit signup/quickstart page walking through account creation and 'Get your API key' steps, nor any statement ruling out sales/waitlist gating. Missing for 10: an explicit getting-started/quickstart doc describing sign-up flow and first API key generation, and confirmation there is no approval/waitlist gate.
